meta.name: pitch-deck-visuals
meta.description: Investor pitch deck structure with slide-by-slide framework, visual design rules, and data presentation. Covers the 12-slide framework, chart types, team slides, and common investor turn-offs. Use for: fundraising decks, investor presentations, startup pitch, demo day, grant proposals. Triggers: pitch deck, investor deck, startup pitch, fundraising deck, demo day, pitch presentation, investor presentation, seed deck, series a deck, pitch slides, startup presentation, vc pitch, investor meeting

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作投资人青睐的融资路演幻灯片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在为初创公司准备融资用的路演幻灯片。
copy.tagline_en: Create investor-ready pitch deck slides for fundraising
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing a pitch deck for your startup's fundraising round.

howto.what: Claude 会指导你制作投资人演示文稿，提供12页幻灯片框架、每页设计规则、图表选择建议，并生成幻灯片图片。
howto.when: 当你提到“融资演示”、“投资人演示”、“创业路演”等关键词，或要求制作投资人演示文稿时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一张问题页幻灯片，突出“每周12小时”这个数据。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含大数字和一句话的幻灯片图片。

say.text: 用同心圆图展示TAM/SAM/SOM市场机会。
say.note: Claude 会生成市场机会幻灯片图片。

say.text: 给我一个竞争格局的2x2定位图。
say.note: Claude 会生成竞争分析幻灯片图片。

howto.what_en: Claude guides you to create investor pitch decks: provides a 12-slide framework, design rules, chart types, and generates slide images via CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'pitch deck', 'investor deck', 'startup pitch', 'fundraising deck', 'demo day', etc., or ask to create an investor presentation.

say_en.text: Generate a problem slide highlighting '12 hours per week'.
say_en.note: Claude will produce a slide image with a big number and one sentence.
Claude will generate a market opportunity slide image.

say_en.text: Create a 2x2 positioning map for competition.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a competitive landscape slide image.
